subject: Insurance
title: Correlation and Accumulation Risk
description: Learn Correlation and Accumulation Risk in one minute.

hook.text: If one house burns, that's one claim. If a wildfire burns 10,000 houses, that's 10,000 simultaneous claims.

buildup.text: Insurance works by spreading independent risks.

discovery.text: Accumulation risk is the total exposure in one area.

climax.text: Correlation is the enemy of insurance diversification. Events that hit everything at once are what bankrupt companies.

punchline.text: One fire: manageable. Ten thousand fires: catastrophe.

quiz.question: Why is correlation dangerous for insurers?
options: Correlated events cause massive simultaneous claims
